what_this_lane_repairs.defect: getModelPerformanceReport built its pick -> settlement map by skipping every settlement_records row whose corrects_id is set, keeping only each chain's root. A corrected pick was therefore reported with its superseded result and CLV. The in-memory test that covered the path asserted the inverted behaviour ('correction rows excluded').
what_this_lane_repairs.repair: Each pick's rows are resolved to the chain tip with resolveEffectiveSettlement. A chain incomplete inside the 30-day listRecent window is completed from listByPick. A chain that still does not resolve -- orphan correction, two roots, a branch, a cycle -- is not counted as settled and is counted in unresolvedSettlementPickCount. A pick whose effective record is manual_review is not counted as settled.
what_this_lane_repairs.why_the_reconcile_check: resolveEffectiveSettlement accepts any lone record without reading corrects_id and otherwise ignores rows its root-to-tip walk does not reach. A chain is accepted only when every corrects_id target is present and correction_depth + 1 equals its row count.

unit_tests.label: The inverted 'correction rows excluded' test is replaced by four: (10) a corrected pick reports the correction's loss and CLV -1.0, not the original win; (11) a chain whose root predates the read window is completed from listByPick, not dropped; (12) a correction whose target cannot be read is excluded and counted in unresolvedSettlementPickCount; (13) a chain whose tip is manual_review is not a settlement and not unresolved.
Full workspace unit suite on this tree.
